column3: the whole row is unreadable: the agent — has nothing to check «an outcome with kept_at = at is already written» with (N1.5 apply): does not execute the edits of the answer in this pass (a repeat of an executed edit is worse than waiting), does not send the field outcomes of the publication (N1.5 publication.outcomes) and does not remove outcomes, the cause goes to the log; an exception to the rule of the only writer: new outcomes are not written over the unreadable row — the edits of the answer are not executed while the row is unreadable, the row stays, the cause goes to the log (the operator)
